overview_description.description: Kaigo Health delivers an AI-enabled care management platform that supports post-discharge follow-ups, remote patient monitoring, and ongoing engagement for Medicare and senior populations. The software automates outreach via phone, SMS, and chat to check symptoms, medication adherence, and vitals from connected devices. Risk scoring and triage flag issues early, route tasks to care teams, and surface readmission risk for timely intervention. Dashboards visualize patient status and trends and translate insights into next-step actions within existing clinical workflows. APIs and integrations connect to electronic health records and care team tools to streamline data capture and handoffs. Use cases include transitional care management, chronic disease management, and preventative outreach for provider groups and payer programs.
